messages.content: I need you to send a message over sideband to the cellphone every 20 seconds for the next 30 minutes. Each message should be a number. Starting from one and then adding one, so the next number is 2 and so on and so forth.
The sideband message interval of 20 seconds for 30 minutes has been confirmed with starting number 1. All parameters are set and ready to execute.
